import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor')
import ctypes
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
from netnomos.discovery import discover_clauses

def make_job(nf=8, slots=2, sizes=(2,)*8, npred=32, width=4, ntrain=10000, mode='rare', seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    fields = []
    for i in range(nf):
        t = ['time','size','count','id','flag'][i % 5]
        fields.append({'name': 'f%d' % i, 'type': t, 'domain': sorted(rng.sample(range(0, 1000000), sizes[i]))})
    numeric = [f for f in fields if f['type'] in ('time','size','count')]
    preds = []
    for k in range(npred):
        which = k % 4
        if which == 0:
            f = numeric[k % len(numeric)]
            preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[k % slots, f['name']]},
                          'op':['eq','ne','lt','gt'][k//len(numeric) % 4],
                          'right':{'const': rng.choice(f['domain']), 'type': f['type']}})
        elif which == 1:
            f = numeric[k % len(numeric)]
            preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'scale': 65535, 'ref':[k % slots, f['name']]},
                          'op':'le','right':{'const': rng.randint(0, 65535*1000000), 'type': f['type']}})
        elif which == 2:
            f = numeric[k % len(numeric)]
            picks = list({(s, f['name']) for s in range(slots)})[:slots]
            preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'sum':picks},'op':'ge',
                          'right':{'const': rng.randint(0, 4000000), 'type': f['type']}})
        else:
            f = fields[k % nf]
            preds.append({'kind':['any','all'][k % 2],'field':f['name'],
                          'op':['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge'][k % 6],'value': rng.randint(0,1000000)})
    if mode == 'rare':   # predicates rarely true -> almost no covers (max DFS nodes)
        train = []
        for _ in range(ntrain):
            row = []
            for slot in range(slots):
                row.append([f['domain'][0] if f['type'] in ('time','size','count') and rng.random()<0.7 else rng.choice(f['domain']) for f in fields])
            train.append(row)
    else:
        train = [[[rng.choice(f['domain']) for f in fields] for _ in range(slots)] for _ in range(ntrain)]
    approved = []
    queries = []
    for q in range(64):
        target = [rng.randrange(slots), rng.choice(fields)['name']]
        fixed = []
        queries.append({'fixed': fixed, 'target': target, 'prefix': rng.choice(['','1','10','0','99','123456'])})
    return {'fields': fields, 'slots': slots, 'predicates': preds, 'width': width,
            'train': train, 'approved': approved, 'queries': queries}

for mode in ('rare','rand'):
    job = make_job(mode=mode, seed=hash(mode) % 1000)
    t0 = time.time()
    out = compile_job(job)
    print(mode, 'time %.2fs' % (time.time()-t0), 'rules', len(out['rules']))

# synthetic worst case for discovery: every 4-subset a minimal cover, big universe
P, U, N = 32, 65536, 4960
rng = random.Random(5)
triples = [(a,b,c) for a in range(P) for b in range(a+1,P) for c in range(b+1,P)]
ftrain=[]; strain=[]
# row i falsifies exactly the triple members
truth = [[1]*P for _ in range(len(triples))]
for i,(a,b,c) in enumerate(triples):
    truth[i][a]=truth[i][b]=truth[i][c]=0
falsify_train=[sum((0 if truth[i][p] else 1)<<i for i in range(len(triples))) for p in range(P)]
satisfy_train=[((1<<len(triples))-1)^m for m in falsify_train]
falsify_universe=[]
for p in range(P):
    # universe window u falsifies p with prob ~0.5 -> covers rarely falsifiable
    bits = rng.getrandbits(U)
    falsify_universe.append(bits)
t0=time.time()
res = discover_clauses(falsify_train, satisfy_train, falsify_universe, 4, len(triples), U)
print('synthetic discovery: %.2fs clauses=%d' % (time.time()-t0, len(res)))
